title: Clean a cloth: C grabs a towel and never recovers, E finds the cloth
goal: put a clean cloth in cabinet.
shows: C walks to the towelholder, takes a towel (not a cloth), tries `clean towel` (invalid) and loops on invalid moves. E, shown "scan the bathtubbasin and countertops first", goes to the bathtubbasin, finds cloth 2 and finishes in 7 steps.
why_interesting: A win that depends partly on a lucky rule: the Corrected Error mentions the bathtubbasin, which happens to be right for this room. Good example for discussing room-specific rules.
